name: Mobile app testing and automation
note: Questions authored by Claude as practice material. Not sourced from your own notes or any official exam. Verify anything you doubt against the docs.

questions.q: Appium drives apps using which protocol style?
questions.why: Appium extends the WebDriver protocol to mobile.

questions.q: Which locator is usually most stable on mobile?
questions.why: Accessibility ids are explicit and cross-platform friendly.

questions.q: Which scenario is specific to mobile testing?
options: Incoming call or notification during use
questions.why: Interruptions, permissions and background/foreground are mobile concerns.

questions.q: Why test on real devices as well as emulators?
options: Real devices expose hardware, performance and OEM differences
